notes.title: LAST CHANCE TO PLAY THE DEMO
notes.content: Last chance to play the demo. The Unrest demo will be removed from access shortly until the full release. Your feedback is very important to us in improving the game. Feel free to share your feedback.

notes.title: LAST UPDATE
notes.content:
We have released the Unrest demo 0.0.2.9 update. Key highlights:
[list]
[*]Trapper character added
[*]Grenade launcher added
[*]Mine trapping added
[*]Climbing function added for Scout
[*]HUD improved
[/list]

notes.title: THE FIRST PATCH HAS BEEN RELEASED
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The "Quick Match" option has been added to the main menu.
[*] The damage of the Viper (shotgun) has been increased.
[*] The warmup time has been changed to 60 seconds.
[*] Several collision issues in the maps have been fixed.
[*] The HUD has been modified to keep the teammate's name visible at all times (it turns red when they are dead).
[*] The weapon hit notify sound bug has been fixed, its volume has been increased, and the interval has been made constant.
[*] Bot names have been rearranged.
[*] The ping indicator levels on the HUD have been changed. The levels are now: 50, 75, 100.
[/list]

notes.title: WOULD YOU LIKE TO PLAY WITH THE DEVELOPERS?
notes.content: We are in the game every day from 18:00 to 21:00 (UTC) during the event. If you want to explore the world of Unrest together, join us.

notes.title: Demo Available Now
notes.content: Great news, everyone! We are thrilled to announce that the demo for our game, "Unrest," is now available on Steam! Dive into the world of "Unrest" and experience a glimpse of the adventure that awaits you. Don't miss out—try the demo today and let us know what you think!

notes.title: DEMO WILL BE AVAILABLE SOON
notes.content: From July 29 to August 5, you can download and experience the demo for free until the end of the festival.
